content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-322. - Contents of ordinance.
content.summary:
In any ordinance adopting a contract, it shall not be necessary to set forth the contract
               in full, but it shall only be necessary to refer to the contract by reference along
               with a description of the subject matter of the proposed contract.
(Code 1960, § 2-3.3(b); Code …
